Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
1)If I get control of an untapped ally via Far Mastery or similar, can he
act immediately?

2)If I play Blood of Acid, is the opposing minion hit back only by the
damage he deals with strikes, or by the environmental damage too?

3)Can I wait to play Rotschreck 'till my opponent plays Strike: Combat Ends,
or I have to play it first.
Can you explain (again, since I'm still not catching the text) how it works
exactly?

Thanx

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <SLwf7.5184$i9.2...@news.infostrada.it>, Cartman <federico-
ne...@libero.it> writes

>1)If I get control of an untapped ally via Far Mastery or similar, can he
>act immediately?

Yep.

>2)If I play Blood of Acid, is the opposing minion hit back only by the
>damage he deals with strikes, or by the environmental damage too?

"he or she" (card text) does not inflict environmental damage.

>3)Can I wait to play Rotschreck 'till my opponent plays Strike: Combat Ends,
>or I have to play it first.

It depends on the ordering of the effects. You play Rotschreck when an
attempt to strike with aggravated damage is declared which must be
effective at the current range. If you're the defending minion, this
may well be after your opponent declares their strike as S:CE.

>Can you explain (again, since I'm still not catching the text) how it works
>exactly?

A minion (A) attempts a strike with aggravated damage. (Watch the
rulings for the fact that it has to be effective at the current range,
however.) Play Rotschreck. Combat Ends. Opposing vampire (B) goes to
torpor. Put Rotschreck on (B) in torpor. Follow card text regarding
their next untap phase.

James Coupe wrote:
> Cartman <federi...@libero.it> writes

> >1)If I get control of an untapped ally via Far Mastery or similar, can he
> >act immediately?
>
> Yep.

Correct.

> >2)If I play Blood of Acid, is the opposing minion hit back only by the
> >damage he deals with strikes, or by the environmental damage too?
>
> "he or she" (card text) does not inflict environmental damage.

Correct (meaning that the environmental damage doesn't "hit back").

> >3)Can I wait to play Rotschreck 'till my opponent plays Strike: Combat Ends,
> >or I have to play it first.
>
> It depends on the ordering of the effects. You play Rotschreck when an
> attempt to strike with aggravated damage is declared which must be
> effective at the current range. If you're the defending minion, this
> may well be after your opponent declares their strike as S:CE.

You may play Rotschreck after both minions have chosen their strikes,
regardless of which one is the strike which "triggers" the Rotschreck.
[LSJ 17-FEB-1999]

> >Can you explain (again, since I'm still not catching the text) how it works
> >exactly?
>
> A minion (A) attempts a strike with aggravated damage. (Watch the
> rulings for the fact that it has to be effective at the current range,
> however.) Play Rotschreck. Combat Ends. Opposing vampire (B) goes to
> torpor. Put Rotschreck on (B) in torpor. Follow card text regarding
> their next untap phase.

Correct.
